How do you stop a forger who can afford any fee? Make identities contestable: a newcomer locks 240 units for 15 epochs, challengeable in 3.

What happens on a challenge? 9 jurors decide within 2 epochs; proven forgery forfeits 80%, and 25% of the slash rewards the challenger.

What does the attacker pay? 1,000 fakes lock 240,000 units; at a 30% catch rate one round burns 57,600. No haven shelters a fake a willow thread can pull down.
